issue.title: Web PDF bookmarks drop the space where a heading wraps ("codereviews", "leveragingCodex")
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-os.4 note #2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP); triaged and independently reproduced by the bob-cli-os land agent on 2026-11-22.

Chrome builds the PDF outline (`print_pdf` with `outline=True, tagged=True` in `scripts/web_clip/web_clip_adapter.py`) from the rendered heading text. Where a heading wraps onto a second line, the space at the soft line break is dropped from the bookmark title. Every wrapped `masthead-title` H1 is affected, on web articles and podcast dossiers alike, so the bookmark text disagrees with the note title and the PDF Info title.

Fix direction (worker decides): give Chrome an outline source that does not depend on line layout, or rewrite outline titles after printing from the known heading text. bob already knows the exact title when it stamps the PDF (`pdf_target::stamp_pdf_to_scratch`). Also check h2/h3 headings that wrap. Add a regression check (an adapter self-test, or a Rust test reading the outline) for a title long enough to wrap.

task_type_fields.impact: Bryan's Highlights/PDF-viewer bookmark panel shows run-together words for most long web and podcast reference titles, and outline-based navigation or search misses them. Low severity, but it affects every new web capture.
task_type_fields.location: scripts/web_clip/web_clip_adapter.py print_pdf (outline=True, tagged=True) on the web_clip_render masthead-title h1
task_type_fields.repro: On apollo, read the outline of filed web PDFs: `mutool show ~/bob/lib/blogs/software_factories_and_code_reviews_with_harjot_gill.pdf outline` prints "Software factories and codereviews with Harjot Gill". The Satya Nadella dossier prints "Software engineering aftercode becomes cheap withSatya Nadella". Ordinary web clips show the same: "Agentic coding is straining CI. Here’show we scaled test impact analysis atAnthropic", "Benchmarking Coding Agents onDatabricks’ Multi-Million LineCodebase", "Harness engineering: leveragingCodex in an agent-first world". Titles that fit on one line ("AI Evals: Everything You Need to Know") are correct.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-os.4 dossier visual check found that wrapped H1 bookmarks lose a space, and the land agent reproduced it on existing web clips too. It is a general web-clip renderer defect, not podcast-specific, so it falls outside the Spotify epic.
